english.note: Use this conversational pattern when the emphasis is on being unable to resist and then doing the tempting action.
Use this when an expression or action comes out despite trying not to do it, such as smiling or laughing.

examples.english: I couldn't resist the freshly baked egg tarts, so I decided to indulge and eat two.
examples.traditional: 我一見到啱啱出爐嘅蛋撻，就忍唔住食咗兩個。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 gin3 dou2 ngaam1 ngaam1 ceot1 lou4 ge3 daan6 taat1 zau6 jan2 m4 zyu6 sik6 zo2 loeng5 go3

examples.english: I couldn't escape laughing when I saw his face.
examples.traditional: 我睇到佢個樣，忍唔住笑咗。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tai2 dou2 keoi5 go3 joeng6 jan2 m4 zyu6 siu3 zo2
